title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer


Location: Coventry

Salary: Competitive, DOE

Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

We're working with an established organisation looking to appoint an experienced Data Engineer to join its growing technology team.

This is an opportunity to work on modern data platforms, develop scalable data solutions and play a key role in improving how data is collected, processed and utilised across the business.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Develop and optimise data integration and transformation solutions.
  • Work with large datasets to ensure data quality, reliability and accessibility.
  • Support the development of data warehouses and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Collaborate with developers, analysts and wider technical teams.
Skills & Experience
  • Strong experience with SQL and Python.
  • Experience designing and maintaining data pipelines.
  • Knowledge of ETL/ELT processes and data modelling.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks or similar would be advantageous.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively.
Interested?

If you're an experienced Data Engineer looking for your next opportunity, we'd be keen to hear from you.

Apply now or get in touch for a confidential discussion.
